scene.name: Choose a feel
scene.purpose: Compare foam, dense gel and bounce, then apply one profile to the recipe.
on_enter: Build three equal-scale sample toys with the current colour. Restore material selection; gel default.
The first press selects and demonstrates a sample. A separate Squeeze button can replay the selected sample.
Count a material as tried once its first completed press/release cycle reaches near-rest; a tap auto-cycle qualifies.
on_exit: Stop sample solvers and audio; commit chosen material.
scene.persistence: draft.recipe.materialId and triedMaterials set. First-time material trial updates durable profile.discoveryMetrics; evaluate unlocks but queue celebrations until a safe boundary.
scene.back_rule: Back 04; Next 06 without requiring all three trials. All material trials are optional exploration.
acceptance: Material identity is visible with no sound.
30/60fps and fixed-pressure input produce coherent responses.
Revisiting the same sample does not repeat a discovery grant.
implementation_notes: Foam renders stored inclusions as sparse surface decoration instead of implying visible internal transparency.
No real finger-pressure detection is required, and the screen cannot physically resist the finger.

actions.trigger: Press/release sample or activate its semantic button
actions.command: Select material; run contact or auto-cycle; at near-rest call recordMaterialTried(id)
actions.state_write: Set materialId; bump recipeRevision only if changed; tried set/grants use idempotent ledger.
actions.feedback: Foam 2.8s, gel 1.1s, bounce 0.55s near-rest starting targets.
actions.interrupt: Cancel is release; incomplete abandoned press without completed cycle does not mark tried.

actions.command: Run 350ms centre press then chosen profile recovery
actions.interrupt: New press supersedes solver continuously; no stacked cycles.

actions.command: Checkpoint; route.push(06); show queued discovery only once scene is ready
actions.interrupt: Do not show unlock during active sample contact.
